ai_validation: Existing leave-one-site-out out-of-fold predictions from Experiment 2.
mathematical_method: Kuznetsov X50 using reconstructed pattern geometry and site-specific back-solved rock factors.
factor_caveat: 2010 and 2012 rock factors are back-solved from published predictions, not independently measured.
geometry_caveats: Soma has an unresolved burden/diameter conflict.
Miami is not included in the selected surface dataset.
interpretation_warning: Prediction coverage differs between methods. Compare coverage before interpreting the metrics. This is not independent validation of Kuznetsov.
